shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,200p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
cat package.json
cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"createMessageHandler\\(|createServer\\(\" src/transport --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '120,220p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
git log --oneline -6
git show --stat --oneline HEAD"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
rg -n \"session_list|list_sessions\" src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/sender.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts specs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md
if test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "lists sessions for the authenticated" src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts --runInBand --silent'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
git status --short --branch'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && git commit -m "Wire session store into WebSocket handler" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
